Disclaimer

Estimates, not official figures

Every calculator on PakToolkit — bijli bill, salary tax, zakat, MDCAT aggregate and the rest — provides an estimate calculated from published rates, slabs and formulas. The official document always wins: your DISCO-issued electricity bill, an FBR assessment, a university merit list or a government notification overrides anything shown here.

Rates change

Electricity tariffs, tax slabs and the zakat nisab are revised through official notifications from time to time. We update PakToolkit after such changes and, where a figure can vary, we make it editable on the page itself so you can match your latest official document.

No professional advice

Nothing on PakToolkit is legal, tax, religious or financial advice. For personal decisions — especially zakat and tax — consult a qualified scholar or professional alongside the official sources.

PakToolkit — free online tools for Pakistan. Every tool runs in your browser; your files never leave your device.
